items.title: 30% Welcome Bonus
items.description: Fund your first account with $500 or more — get +30% in trading funds. The bonus counts towards margin and helps you withstand drawdowns.
items.terms: Bonus up to $5,000. Available once; released at 1 lot per every $10 of bonus.

items.title: Up to 15% Spread Cashback
items.description: Trade 50+ lots a month — we return part of the spread in real money to your account. The bigger the volume, the higher the rate.
items.terms: Credited automatically on the first day of the following month. No cap on the amount.

items.title: Demo Trading Contest
items.description: A monthly competition on demo accounts with a $10,000 prize pool. Three winners receive live trading accounts funded with the prize money.
items.terms: Free to enter. A new round starts on the 1st of every month.

items.title: Refer a Friend — Get $50
items.description: Share your personal link: when your friend opens an account and starts trading, you both receive $50 on your trading accounts.
items.terms: Your friend must deposit at least $100 and trade 1 lot within 30 days.
